model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the relationship between training and validation loss over a series of steps. The x-axis is labeled “Steps” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 250 with tick labels at intervals of 25. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.02 to 0.07 with tick labels at intervals of 0.01. There are two lines in the plot. The first, representing "Training Loss," is blue with circular markers and a solid line style; it begins at approximately 0.058 at step 0 and decreases to approximately 0.022 at step 250, exhibiting a generally decreasing trend with several local minima and maxima. The second line, representing “Validation Loss,” is orange with circular markers and follows a solid line style; it begins at approximately 0.043 at step 0 and decreases to approximately 0.021 at step 250, also displaying a generally decreasing trend with local fluctuations.
